== Notes ==
* The caster ''will not'' gain energy if the enchantment is renewed before it ends.
* Use a [[List of enchantment removal skills#On self|self-enchantment removal skill]] (e.g. [[Contemplation of Purity]]) to forcefully trigger the energy gain.
* Consider using [[Energy Drain]] over this skill, as it provides more net energy and doesn't have a delay.
* An [[of Enchanting]] weapon upgrade is not advised, as it will delay the energy gain.

== Trivia ==
* This is the only [[Mantra]] that is not a [[Stance]].
